normal: A close-up of a 3D printing nozzle and freshly extruded plastic; the extruded material forms a smooth, even layer or strand of steady width with straight, clean edges. The background around it may be dark or light.
defective: A close-up of a 3D printing nozzle and extruded plastic where the amount of material is wrong: either a thin, stringy strand with breaks or gaps within the plastic itself, or a bulging, blobby, overly wide mass of plastic.
